visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Form reloads the page
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Pressing Save makes the page reload and the thank-you message vanishes at once. The handler shows the message, but the browser's own submit still goes ahead.

solution.explanation: Submitting a form sends it to a new address and reloads the page. Calling preventDefault in the submit handler cancels that, so the page stays and the message remains visible.

checks.label: The browser's own submit is stopped
